result.stdout:
Vela.Cli
Commands:
  plan [--package <plugin.nupkg>]... [--packages-dir <folder>] [--package-assembly <name.dll>] [--connection-string <value>] [--url <envUrl> --tenant-id <tenant> --client-id <appId> --client-secret <secret>] [--environment <label>] [--out <file>] [--interactive] [--strict] [--verbose]
  apply [same args as plan] [--solution <solutionUniqueName>] [--execute] [--strict] [--verbose]
  inspect [same args as plan] [--verbose]
  init --name <SolutionName> [--prefix <Prefix>] [--output <dir>] [--no-integrations] [--no-tests] [--no-console] [--core-version <ver>] [--managed-identity] [--force] [--interactive]
  add plugin <Name> --entity <ModelType> [--message Create|Update|Delete] [--project <csproj>] [--force]
  add customapi <Name> [--entity <ModelType>] [--project <csproj>] [--force]
  models (--solution <uniquename> | --entities <a,b,c>) [--namespace <ns>] [--out <dir>] [--no-annotations] [--overwrite] [connection options]
  sign --package <path.nupkg> (--fingerprint <hex> | (--pfx <file> | --pfx-base64 <content>) (--pfx-password <pw> | --pfx-credential <target>)) [--timestamp <url>]
  menu                        Launch the interactive menu (also the default when run with no arguments in a terminal).
  version                     Print the tool version.

Auth options:
  Client secret resolution order: --client-secret <value> (warned), --client-secret-stdin, DATAVERSE_CLIENT_SECRET env var.
  --auth-client-id <appId>   Override the MSAL public client id used for --interactive browser login.
  --authority <url>          Override the MSAL authority (e.g. for sovereign clouds).
  --verbose also prints full exception stack traces on failure.

Examples:
  dataverse-framework plan --package .\bin\Release\Zava.Plugins.Package.1.0.0.nupkg --url https://zava.crm.dynamics.com --tenant-id <tenantId> --client-id <appId> --client-secret <secret>
  dataverse-framework plan --packages-dir .\artifacts\packages --connection-string "$env:DATAVERSE_CONNECTION_STRING"
  dataverse-framework plan --interactive
  vela in
[truncated]
